options.text: The gravitational potential energy of the bob is smallest at W.

A strip of iron and a strip of brass are firmly attached to each other along their entire length. This
combination is a bimetallic strip.
iron strip
brass strip

iron
fixed support
brass

What causes the bimetallic strip to become straight again?

options.text: The brass contracts more than the iron.
The brass expands more than the iron.
The iron contracts more than the brass.
The iron expands more than the brass.

Oil has a lower boiling point than water.
The oil has a larger thermal capacity than the water.
The oil has a smaller thermal capacity than the water.

Convection currents only occur in solids and liquids.

questions.questionText:
Visible light, X-rays and microwaves are all components of the electromagnetic spectrum.
Which statement about the waves is correct?

options.text: In a vacuum, microwaves travel faster than visible light and have a shorter wavelength.
